title: The AI Review Loop
premise: Three AI reviews return a developer’s code to its original state.

scenes.anchor: Opus, can you help me review Astra's code?
scenes.label: hook
scenes.description: The price formatter already turns 5 into £5.00. Alex asks Opus to help review Astra’s code.

scenes.label: opus_first
scenes.description: Opus shortens the function. Its price stays visible.

scenes.label: gemini_request
scenes.description: Alex turns to Gemini and asks her to check Opus’s fix.

scenes.anchor: Too simple. It needs a proper architecture.
scenes.label: gemini_first
scenes.description: Alex glances across as Gemini proposes a proper architecture. Three modules pile up around the same price.

scenes.label: astra_request
scenes.description: Astra enters the same open stage for the next review.

scenes.label: astra_first
scenes.description: Astra collapses the modules back into the original function.

scenes.label: again
scenes.description: Alex hovers over Merge, then pulls away as he requests another review.

scenes.label: simplify
scenes.description: The editor contracts into a file card over Opus’s hand as she says Let’s simplify.

scenes.label: rebuild
scenes.description: The same file swings to Gemini on Rebuild and she changes its contents.

scenes.label: restart
scenes.description: The third and quickest pass lands with Astra. The original code returns.

scenes.label: compare
scenes.description: Astra’s card opens into the comparison. Alex asks Any change and the blue zero answers.

scenes.anchor: We've been here for three hours.
scenes.label: hours
scenes.description: Alex facepalms beside the zero-change comparison.

scenes.label: cleaner
scenes.description: Opus proudly says Much cleaner and holds her reaction.
